name: Deliberately false: theta without the 1 in the min, degree 2, cell extrema
source: a typo of Zhang and Shu, J. Comput. Phys. 229 (2010), (2.8)-(2.11), Lemma 2.4, Theorem 2.5

claims.why: avg(p~) = ubar + theta (avg(p) - ubar) = ubar for any scalar theta
the ratio terms alone already give the bounds
p = y in [m, M] = [-1, 1] needs no limiting, but theta = 2 and p~ = 2y: |p~ - p| = 1/2 > 0 = C * overshoot
